task_description: Activate the MCP tool group "laplace_google_maps" (Google Maps server) and call the tool "get_place_details" exactly once. Goal: fetch detailed place information (rating, address, photos, attributes/amenities such as outdoor seating) for the top candidate cafe near Central Park in New York City, so we can confirm it is highly-rated and has outdoor seating suitable for sitting outside. Return the full raw tool output including the cafe name, rating, review count, address, latitude/longitude coordinates, and any evidence of outdoor seating. Important constraints: do NOT call any other tools besides activating the group and calling get_place_details. If the group activation or the tool call returns an error or times out, clearly state that the step was skipped along with the exact error message, and do not retry or invent results.

Activate the MCP tool group "laplace_weather_data" (Weather Data server) and call the tool "search_locations_tool" exactly once. Goal: map Central Park, New York City to a weather location ID for a subsequent forecast lookup. Input to use: Central Park coordinates latitude 40.7829, longitude -73.9654 (or query text "Central Park, New York"). Note: the preceding Google Maps step was skipped because that tool group was unavailable, so these coordinates are the well-known approximate values rather than data returned from an earlier tool call. Return the full raw tool output including any location name, latitude, longitude, country, state, and especially the location ID / key needed for a forecast query. Important constraints: do NOT call any other tools besides activating the group and calling search_locations_tool. If the group activation or the tool call returns an error or times out, clearly state that the step was skipped along with the exact error message, and do not retry or invent results.
